name: Novel object recognition test
description: After a familiarization trial with two identical objects, the animal is tested with one familiar and one novel object. Assesses recognition memory: an animal that remembers the familiar object spends more time exploring the novel one.

parameters.label: Arena width
parameters.help: Internal width of the arena floor, measured wall to wall along the horizontal axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Arena depth
parameters.help: Internal depth of the arena floor, measured wall to wall along the vertical axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Exploration radius
parameters.help: Sniffing directed at an object counts as exploration only within this distance of the object.

parameters.label: Minimum total exploration time
parameters.help: No discrimination index is computed for animals whose combined exploration of both objects falls below this value. Set to 0 to disable the criterion.

inputEvents.label: Object exploration
inputEvents.definition: Nose directed toward an object within object_zone_radius_cm; climbing or sitting on the object does not count as exploration.

events.label: Novel object exploration
events.definition: Novel object exploration bouts, with overlapping intervals merged.

events.label: Familiar object exploration
events.definition: Familiar object exploration bouts, with overlapping intervals merged.

metrics.label: Novel object exploration time
metrics.description: Time spent exploring the novel object.
metrics.definition: Total length of the union of novel object exploration intervals; overlapping time is counted once.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when exploration was not scored.

metrics.label: Familiar object exploration time
metrics.description: Time spent exploring the familiar object.
metrics.definition: Total length of the union of familiar object exploration intervals.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when exploration was not scored.

metrics.label: Total exploration time
metrics.description: Time spent exploring either object; very low values make the discrimination index unreliable.
metrics.definition: Sum of the novel and familiar object exploration times.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when exploration was not scored.

metrics.label: Discrimination index
metrics.description: Preference for the novel object, from -1 to +1. Positive values indicate that the familiar object is remembered; values near 0 indicate no preference.
metrics.definition: Relative exploration of the novel object, from -1 (familiar object only) to +1 (novel object only).
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when exploration was not scored, (BELOW_EXPLORATION_CRITERION) when total exploration time is below min_total_exploration_s, and (ZERO_DENOMINATOR) when it is 0.
